[b]2025: The Peace Offer[/b]

With the provisional government of [nation]Sikirsk[/nation] offering a peace deal to Thýven, plans would be drawn up for a "lasting peace" in Sikirsk, while no official date would be made or given for a meeting with the officials of the Sikirsk "government" the plan would be sent over to them.

[i]2025 Peace Plan[/i]
"In order to ensure a lasting peace, the government of Thýven herefore presents the following, to the government of Sikirsk.

1. The government of Sikirsk is to deport its government leaders to Thýven as retribution for hacking a classified THEP meeting and stealing information thus.

2. The government of Sikirsk is to disband itself and allow a provisional THEP government to be put in place until such a time arises when the members of THEP find it well to form a more perfect government.

Failure to accept these terms will result in a continuation of the previous assault against your nation. Negotiation is feasible.
